Trichobothrial_Air_Current_Receptors.description: Arachnids lack true ears entirely. Instead, they rely on 'trichobothria'—incredibly fine, wildly elongated sensory hairs sitting in frictionless cup-like sockets. They detect the incredibly faint, low-frequency pressure wave generated by a highly stealthy flying wasp from meters away.

Slit_Sensilla_Strain_Gauges.description: Microscopic, perfectly shaped slits carved precisely into the exoskeleton near the limb joints. Functioning as biological strain gauges, they instantly detect the minute structural deformations traveling through the spider's own web, identifying the exact weight and struggle-frequency of caught prey.

Tarsal_Chemosensory_Auditory_Hairs.description: Hairs on the absolute tips of the toes that are heavily innervated by dual receptors. They 'hear' via vibration but simultaneously 'taste' the chemical signature of the object vibrating, allowing the entity to effortlessly distinguish between a struggling fly and a falling leaf.

Lyriform_Web_Tuning_Organs.description: Aggregations of slit sensilla arranged tightly in a lyriform (harp-like) pattern. The entity uses these to actively 'tune' its web like a horrific musical instrument, perfectly plucking the silk threads to detect harmonic weaknesses in the snare.

Pectine_Ground_Vibration_Combs.description: Feather-like, highly complex comb structures heavily dragging directly across the ground from the scorpion's belly. They detect inconceivably faint seismic thumps generated by subterranean earthworms, allowing flawless triangulation of buried prey.

Acoustic_Web_Resonance_Cavities.description: An incredibly imaginative approach where the entity physically weaves an enormous, highly specialized acoustic, parabolic dish out of silk. The spider sits at the focal point, using the web exactly like a highly tuned satellite radio telescope to hear predators crossing the forest.

Joint_Embedded_Proprioceptors.description: Lacking any external acoustic receptors, this entity is truly entirely deaf to airborne sound. It relies completely on deep-tissue joint proprioceptors that effortlessly detect the violent, echoing shockwaves of loud thunder directly through the earth.

Stridulation_Frequency_Receivers.description: Highly specialized patches of mechanoreceptors tuned explicitly and exclusively to the exact aggressive, hissing stridulation frequencies produced by rival males violently rubbing their chelicerae together.

Pedipalp_Mounted_Vibration_Nodes.description: The 'ears' are mounted completely on the vastly elongated, highly mobile boxing-glove like pedipalps. The entity actively directs its pedipalps individually around corners like highly sophisticated boom microphones.

Water_Surface_Tension_Ripplers.description: The entity rests heavily with all eight feet perfectly placed identically upon the surface tension of a completely still pond. It analyzes microscopic concentric ripples acting exactly like acoustic soundwaves traveling effortlessly across the water's surface.
